title: Buildings ablaze, petrol bombs hurled at parliament: 10 visuals show chaos of Albania protests
summary_full: Protests in Tirana against Prime Minister Rama have escalated, marked by violent confrontations between crowds and law enforcement. Frustrated by rampant corruption and expensive university tuition, protesters have hurled stones and petrol bombs. In reaction, police have unleashed water cannons and tear gas to control the situation, resulting in multiple injuries on both sides. International organizations are urging for an immediate peaceful resolution to the mounting tensions.
